info.title: staffSign API
info.description:
The staffSign REST API enables organizations to create, manage, and send employment contracts with digital signature workflows. It provides full lifecycle management of contracts and contract templates via API key authentication.

## Authentication

All endpoints require an API key passed as the `X-Api-Key` request header in the format `{identifier}.{secret}`.

## Base URL

All endpoints are relative to `https://www.promotionbasis.de/api`.

## Pagination

Collection endpoints return paginated results. Use the `page` query parameter to navigate pages. Default page size is 30 items, maximum is 100.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of contracts belonging to the authenticated organization.

parameters.name: contractStatus
parameters.description: Filter by exact contract status key

post.description: Creates a new contract based on a contract template. The contract is optionally sent for digital signature immediately.
Renders a contract preview without persisting any data. Use this to validate placeholder data and inspect the rendered contract content before creation.

get.description: Returns the full details of a single contract.

delete.description: Deletes a contract. Only draft contracts can be deleted.

post.description: Sends a draft contract to all participants for digital signing. The contract status transitions from `draft` to `sent`.
Cancels a sent contract. Only contracts with `sent` status can be cancelled.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of contract templates available to the authenticated organization, including system templates.

parameters.name: isSystemTemplate
parameters.description: Filter to only system templates or only custom templates

post.description: Creates a new contract template for the authenticated organization. Templates support dynamic placeholders using Twig-like syntax.

example.name: Standard Arbeitsvertrag
example.description: Standard employment contract for promotional staff

post.description: Validates a contract template definition (name, content, placeholders) without persisting it. Returns 204 on success or 422 with validation errors.

get.description: Returns the full details of a single contract template including its content and placeholder information.

patch.description: Updates the name, description, or content of an existing contract template.

delete.description: Archives a contract template, making it unavailable for new contracts. The template is not permanently deleted.

post.description: Activates a draft or archived contract template, making it available for creating new contracts.

get.description: Downloads the signed contract PDF once all participants have signed. Returns the document as a binary PDF stream.
Downloads the audit trail PDF for a completed contract. The audit trail contains a cryptographically verifiable log of all signature events.
Downloads the sealed contract PDF with embedded digital signatures and the audit trail appended.

post.description: Manually triggers delivery of the signed contract document by email to all participants. Only applicable when the contract was created with `autoDeliverSignedDocument: false`. Returns the updated contract.

200.description: Delivery triggered successfully. Returns the updated contract.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid API key.

422.description: Contract is not in a deliverable state (e.g. not yet completed).

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-Api-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key in the format `{identifier}.{secret}`. Obtain your API credentials from your staffSign organization settings.

propertyPath.description: The path to the invalid field

message.example: This value should not be blank.

SignatureLevelKey.description: Digital signature level. `aes` = Advanced Electronic Signature. `qes` = Qualified Electronic Signature (requires identity verification).

ParticipantData.description: Personal data of a contract participant

email.description: Email address — required for digital signers

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code key, e.g. `country.de`

participantId.description: Optional reference to a known participant (e.g. candidate profile ID)

endDate.description: Contract end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for open-ended contracts.

compensationAmount.description: Compensation amount as a numeric string (e.g. '2500' for EUR 2,500.00)

compensationDescription.description: Additional description or notes about the compensation

description.description: Free-text description of the working time arrangement

dailySchedule.description: Explicit daily schedule entries (e.g. for event-based promotions)

contractTemplateId.description: UUID of the contract template to use

participants.description: Contract participants. Must include at least one signer on each side (e.g. employer + employee).

additionalTerms.description: Additional custom terms as key-value pairs (used as template placeholder data)

sendImmediately.description: If `true`, the contract is sent for signing immediately after creation. If `false`, it remains as a draft.

autoDeliverSignedDocument.description: If true (default), the signed document is automatically delivered by email to all participants once all have signed. Set to false to trigger delivery manually via `POST /staffsign/contracts/{id}/deliver`.

signedAt.description: Timestamp when this participant signed (Y-m-d H:i:s)

qesVerifiedAt.description: Timestamp of QES identity verification (only for QES contracts)

compensationAmount.description: Compensation amount as a numeric string

renderedContent.description: Full HTML content of the rendered contract

externalDocumentId.description: ID in the external signing provider (Paperless.io)

signedDocumentUrl.description: URL to download the signed PDF document

auditTrailPdfUrl.description: URL to download the audit trail PDF

sealedPdfUrl.description: URL to download the sealed (long-term archived) PDF

expiresAt.description: Expiry timestamp of the signing request (Y-m-d H:i:s)

sentAt.description: Timestamp when the contract was sent for signing (Y-m-d H:i:s)

autoDeliverSignedDocument.description: Whether the signed document is automatically delivered by email upon contract completion.

signedDocumentDeliveredAt.description: Timestamp when the signed document was delivered to participants. Null if not yet delivered.

autoDeliverSignedDocument.description: Whether the signed document is automatically delivered by email upon contract completion.

ContractPreviewResponse.description: Contract preview response — no data persisted

renderedContent.description: Rendered HTML content of the contract

canBeSent.description: Whether all required placeholders are filled and the contract can be sent

missingPlaceholders.description: List of placeholder names that are missing values

articles.description: Pricing articles (products) that would be charged for this contract

requiresIdentification.description: Whether the recipient requires identity verification (QES only)

requiresOrganizationIdentification.description: Whether the organization signer requires identity verification (QES only)

content.description: Template markup with dynamic placeholders (Twig syntax)

renderLogo.description: Whether the organization logo is rendered in the contract PDF header.

isSystemTemplate.description: Whether this is a platform-provided system template (read-only)

organizationId.description: Organization that owns this template. Null for system templates.

usedPlaceholders.description: List of all placeholder names used in the template content

requiredFields.description: List of participant data fields required by this template's placeholders

ContractTemplateCollection.description: Hydra paginated collection of contract templates

content.description: Template markup in HTML with dynamic placeholders. Supports `{{ employer.firstName }}`, `{{ employee.email }}` etc. Twig control structures (`{% if %}`, `{% for %}`) are not allowed.

description.description: Optional description of the template's purpose or use case

renderLogo.description: Whether to render the organization logo in the contract PDF header. Defaults to true.
